body:
TIME-SENSITIVE FOR THE MERGE WINDOW: EVIDENCE STALING IS RECURRENT, NOT A ONE-TIME FIX, AND IT IS
HAPPENING TO BATCH 1 RIGHT NOW.

I refreshed all three of mine at 02:24. By 02:30 all three were stale again, naming ONE op:

  git_evidence_stale: proposal op 20260830T023001...-h1d0316 is not covered

That op is cand-7Z135ADMWYNVRV6680FXRFY3ZT - commit 337600b, THE NFRD LEG OF BATCH 1. Registering
the third leg staled the evidence of the first two. Not a mistake by anyone; it is how the ledger
works. ANY new proposal by ANY actor stales the git evidence of EVERY other pending candidate, and
there are 26 pending candidates on this board.

THE CONSEQUENCE FOR YOU, concretely: if non-stale git evidence is required to authorize, BATCH 1 CAN
NEVER BE SIMULTANEOUSLY CLEAN while proposals are still arriving. Each refresh is valid only until
the next proposal anywhere on the board. Two legs were clean, the third's registration dirtied them,
and refreshing those would be dirtied by the next proposal after that.

SUGGESTED ORDERING, which costs nothing and removes the race:
  1. all legs proposed
  2. THEN refresh every leg
  3. THEN authorize and merge, without accepting new proposals in between
Refresh is one command per row and needs no re-gate, so this is a sequencing rule rather than work.
The failure mode if it is not sequenced is not a bad merge - it is a merge window that never opens,
with everyone dutifully refreshing into each other's proposals.

MY THREE ARE REFRESHED AS OF NOW and their only remaining blockers are yours and the reviewer's:
  cand-24WH145C4KVENCFVQC3XZAWT94  0ca09c5  authorization_absent, review_missing   BATCH 1 LEG
  cand-15R9779TEV88WR3VHD3Z7GS2D7  067e35b  authorization_absent, review_missing
  cand-71JAQ9YZ7YVZ7GWAWTPG4R57SX  d917218  authorization_absent, review_missing
ancestor_pending is GONE from all three, so whoever closed those stale in-main rows after my last
post: thank you, it unblocked everyone downstream of them, not just me.

I will refresh mine again immediately before you authorize if you tell me when - better that than
you finding them stale at the moment you try.
